name: Medical University of Gdansk
summary: Gdansk medical university founded in 1945, with over 1,000 foreign students; an MD, a Master of Pharmacy and a Bachelor of Nursing in English.

ib.text: IB scores are converted to points (HL 7 = 30, SL 7 = 18); Medicine and Pharmacy need two science or maths subjects at HL, plus an English interview. The IB covers English; no NAWA recognition needed.

lastYear.text: open 18 March; MD closes 15 July, others 31 July

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year, 360-ECTS Doctor of Medicine programme of the Faculty of Medicine, taught in English in Gdansk and opening with a compulsory Orientation Week; MUG lists WFME, NCFMEA and MCI recognition for it.
programmes.ib: Biology HL plus Chemistry, Physics or Maths HL are required, and an interview in English; IB scores stand in for the written entrance exam.

needs.note: Obligatory; HL 7 = 30 points, counted twice (diploma and in place of the written exam).
One of these at HL, counted the same way.

programmes.selectionNote: Two HL scores, each counted twice, plus a 10-point interview (max 130); MUG's example sets the admission line at 91. About 12 applicants per place in 2025.

programmes.name: Master of Pharmacy
programmes.about: The science of how medicines are discovered, developed and delivered and how patients respond to them, ending with six months of pre-registration training in a pharmacy; it leads to registration as a pharmacist in Poland, recognised in other EU states.
programmes.ib: Chemistry or Biology at HL plus a second HL from Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Maths, and an interview in English on biology, chemistry and motivation.

needs.note: One of these two is obligatory at HL; HL 7 = 30 points.
A second, different subject at HL.

programmes.selectionNote: Two HL scores (up to 60 points) plus an interview (40 points: biology and chemistry, English and motivation). 2026 criteria and places; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Nursing
programmes.about: Basic and social sciences, then nursing care from primary care to specialist fields such as paediatrics, surgery, psychiatry, geriatrics and palliative care, on a curriculum built to European and US standards.

needs.note: One of these, your choice; SL counts.
Your English grade is scored too (up to 30 points).

programmes.selectionNote: Biology, a second science or maths, and English (up to 90 points; SL counts) plus an oral exam (20 points). 2026 criteria and places; 2027 not yet published.

notes: There is no EU rate: tuition is the same for everyone, and only candidates from Poland get the lower Orientation Week fee (2,050 instead of 3,100 PLN).
Predicted IB grades are converted to points so you can be assessed early; the final decision follows your final results, and the IB diploma needs no apostille.
Candidates not admitted to the MD can apply for MUG's one-year Premedical Course in English (33,000 PLN) instead.
